newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star Entertainment proposes name change.
newsitem.headline: Star Entertainment proposes name change.

text.p: Star Entertainment (International Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it proposes to change the company name to "China Star Entertainment Ltd" following the change of management of the company in August.
The proposal was subject to shareholders' approval in a special general meeting on November 6, it said in a statement.
Dorest Co Ltd, a private company, held 50.22 percent of Star Entertainment after the close of a general offer in early August.
The company also said further details of its planned rights issue and the supply agreement entered into between the company and Win's Entertainment Ltd would be sent to its shareholders on Monday.
Share regristration for the purpose of determining the entitlements under the rights issue would be closed from October 17 to 23, the company said.
In early September, the company proposed an eight-for-one rights issue to raise HK$268.8 million.
The rights issue and the supply agreement were subject to shareholders' approval in a special general meeting on October 23, it said.
